block/blockframe.tsx.why: The pane header's tooltip. Moves onto AnchoredPopover with the tooltips.

components/context-menu.tsx.why: The right-click menu. Moves onto AnchoredPopover (PR 2 of #23943).

element/modal.tsx.why: The modal layer: a window or pane dialog. Follows chrome zoom in PR 3 of #23943.

element/search.tsx.why: The find box of a pane (editor, terminal): it belongs to the pane's content, whose zoom is the pane's.

element/tooltip.tsx.why: The tooltip. Moves onto AnchoredPopover (PR 2 of #23943).

modals/typeaheadmodal.tsx.why: Mounts inside the pane's own block: pane content, not app chrome.

tab/tab.tsx.why: The tab colour panel. Moves onto AnchoredPopover (PR 2 of #23943).

view/agent/attachments/AttachmentLightbo.why: A full-window viewer for an attachment. Decided with the dialogs (PR 3 of #23943).

view/agent/components/AgentProgressBar.t.why: Mounts a bar into the agent pane's own element: pane content.

view/agent/components/PeekOverlay.tsx.why: Follows the agent pane's zoom (--agent-pane-zoom), not the chrome's: it previews pane content.

view/files/FilesFooter.tsx.why: The Files pane's conflict dialog. Decided with the pane dialogs (PR 3 of #23943).
